messages:
zoe: Quick sync - NimbusEdge asked for an EAP that includes Azure Marketplace packaging + SI pre-integration (Accord Systems). They want NDA + joint blog timing.

partner-rep: NDA draft incoming, expect countersign this week. We can ship 2 devkits + 1 integration kit. We prefer publishable aggregate metrics only (p95, tokens/sec).

legal-bot: Flag: NimbusEdge firmware includes a closed MCU blob. Add NDA annex that disallows firmware redistribution in marketplace images. Export-control check required before we publish any distributable image.

raj: For marketplace, do we build an image or provide guidance/templates? Building might be faster but risks redistributing firmware.

derek: Recommend guidance + templates: sample ARM template, packaging checklist, and VM skeleton with no firmware. Workshop with Accord can cover flashing steps.

ops-bot: Tentative bench window reserved: LR-2026-NIM-08 (2026-04-05 to 2026-04-09). Workshop slot tentatively 2026-04-07 13:00-17:00 PT. Ticket INF-EAP-989 created.

zoe: Action items for Redwood: 1) produce ARM template + marketplace checklist by 2026-03-30; 2) draft 30-min Accord workshop agenda by 2026-03-28.

partner-rep: We'll upload marketplace docs (no firmware) and confirm Accord contact. Also request a short NDA-safe demo script for the joint blog video.

derek: I'll draft a 90s demo script that uses sanitized metrics and a redacted artifact snapshot.

legal-bot: I'll add the NDA annex forbidding firmware redistribution and request partner verification that published images contain no closed blobs. ETA EOD 2026-03-22.

zoe: If NDA returns with annex, I'll send calendar invites and lock workshop. :white_check_mark:
